reason: The old absolute-success score has a strong intervention-gate failure: its top 26 queries contain only one of 39 quality-repair opportunities and incur four quality breaks. With an oracle quality-repair gate, its saved best action repairs 25 of 39. Both gate and sentence choice need work; the audit does not prove paired supervision will generalize.
required_next_protocol: Keep STAY explicit and separate quality repair from token-only saving in labels and evaluation.
Freeze one baseline-relative query-grouped model and a risk-constrained deployment rule before training; do not add multiple new heads or architecture changes without evidence.
Measure scorer GPU time and end-to-end latency as well as Target input tokens.
Use a fresh train-side query holdout for any next research gate if feasible; these 512 OOF outcomes are design-exposed.
Keep sealed research and confirmation sets closed.
